test_is_decorated_with_make_executable: test the executing_impl.is_decorated_with_make_executable function to check if a function has the make_executable decorator
test_returns_awaitable: test the executing_impl.returns_awaitable function to determine if a function returns an awaitable
test_call_and_maybe_await: test the executing_impl.call_and_maybe_await function to call functions with positional, keyword, and partial arguments
test_set_decorated_with_make_executable: test the executing_impl.set_decorated_with_make_executable function to mark a function as decorated with make_executable
test_executable_function_decorator: test the executing.make_executable decorator on sync and async functions to make them executable
